steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Tawhid is the central belief of Islam — there is only one God (Allah), with no partners, equals or divisions. It is the first part of the Shahadah: "There is no god but Allah." Surah 112 (Al-Ikhlas) expresses tawhid: "He is Allah, the One and Only." | Exam Tip: Tawhid influences every aspect of Muslim life: it forbids shirk (associating partners with God), which is the greatest sin in Islam. This is why Muslims reject the Christian Trinity (they see it as shirk) and why images of Allah or Muhammad are forbidden in mosques (to prevent idolatry). | RS Exam Tips — Tawhid: The Oneness of God: 1. For Tawhid: The Oneness of God questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocab

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain two Muslim beliefs about the nature of Allah. | "Tawhid is the most important Muslim belief." Evaluate this statement.
